name: QuickShulker263
description: Quickly open shulker boxes (and ender chests, crafting tables, stonecutters) without placing them down, for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric). Unofficial port of QuickShulker by kyrptonaught (MIT). Press K or right-click a held item to open it. All credit for the original concept and logic goes to kyrptonaught. See NOTICE.
